body:
Closes https://github.com/duckdblabs/duckdb-internal/issues/11294

PR from https://github.com/duckdb-bot/duckdb/pull/130

The encoder now keeps open arrays and objects as frames on an explicit stack and encodes their children one at a time. It reads object entries in key order through a new `VariantObjectIterator::GetOrderedEntries()`. The frame stack is reused across rows. The sort keys do not change. 

**Tests**

`test/issues/general/test_26373.test` builds its values with `variant_bytes_to_variant` instead of a JSON cast, so it keeps working if the cast gets a depth limit
title: Encode VARIANT sort keys with an explicit stack
